description: List Mapbox access tokens for the authenticated user with optional filtering and pagination. Returns metadata for all tokens (public and secret), but the actual token value is only included for public tokens (secret token values are omitted for security). When using pagination, the "start" parameter must be obtained from the "next_start" field of the previous response (it is not a token ID)

default.description: Filter to show only the default public token

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return (1-100)

sortby.description: Sort tokens by created or modified timestamp

start.description: Token ID to start pagination from

name: list_tokens_tool

allowedUrls.description: URLs that the token is restricted to

default.description: Whether this is the default token

expires.description: Expiration time in ISO 8601 format (temporary tokens only)

scopes.description: Array of scopes granted to the token

token.description: The actual access token string (omitted for secret tokens in list responses)

usage.description: Token usage type: pk (public), sk (secret), or tk (temporary)

title: List Mapbox Tokens Tool
